name: Corner Drugstore
axes: glTF Y up, main street front +Z; corner entry outward diagonally (-X,+Z)
origin: Grade at centre of original straight front edge. All four states preserve identical origin and door anchors.

fountain.notes: Fixed counter, taps, prep cabinet and bolted stools only. No loose stock, cups or dispensing behavior.

rooms.notes: Open floor for game-provided merchandise/shelving; fixed rear prescription/service counter.
Clean upper shell with partition opening; reached by the outside rear staircase.

stairs.notes: Real two-flight metal treads, stringers, posts and rails. Height-aware navigation/collision remains runtime work.

sign_name.binding: Exactly one town-name region. Separate blade region carries only generic DRUGS/CAFE descriptor; repaint name region only.

collision.notes: Exterior doorways have no closed panels or gate boxes. Store fixtures are full-height from their supporting floor. Steps, stringers, walls and floors use real architectural contact; runtime needs height-aware traversal.

runtime_handoff: States are alternative simulation-supported outcomes, not an automatic forced timeline.
Cafe requires the old fountain to have been retained, stored or recovered according to actual history; never conjure it after removal.
Closed is a display state, not permission to enter or an invented closure event. Runtime controls business hours, access and state selection.
Open exterior thresholds deliberately carry no panels/gates; all original door positions are identical across states.
Glass/sign emission masks, glTF collision metadata parsing, upper-floor/stair navigation and furnishings need integration.
No residents, brands, prescriptions, inventory, prices, food service or business history are generated.
licence: LimeZu shared swatches are Timerpg-only; retain original credit. Supplemental art and all geometry original.
renders: Actual Blender desktop previews, not Filament/S25 captures.
